submissions.name: lda-real-generalized-eigen
submissions.head: 0fd48aba62d99ea0bf84e1523d037978b8abee62
submissions.title: Keep LDA projections real with a symmetric generalized eigensolver
submissions.body:
### Description

Real-valued training data can produce complex-valued LDA projections because `inv(S_W) @ S_B` is not symmetric. Roundoff can create conjugate pairs in its null eigenspace, which promotes the entire eigenvector array to complex dtype. Even a projection retaining only the nonzero discriminants can then be rejected by downstream scikit-learn estimators.

Solve `S_B v = lambda S_W v` directly with the symmetric generalized eigensolver. Keep descending eigenvalue order and normalize each eigenvector to unit Euclidean length, preserving the existing projection convention. Singular within-class scatter still raises `LinAlgError`. Update the public attribute documentation and changelog.

Fixes #1312. This is separate from #1301: class counts and scatter construction are unchanged.

### Validation

Base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.

[Reproducible validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43875962981/job/133328944010) uses the unchanged frozen dependencies: Python 3.11.18, NumPy 2.4.0, SciPy 1.16.3, scikit-learn 1.8.0 and pandas 2.3.3.

- The 22 new cases produce **3 failures and 19 passes on the exact base**; all pass after the change.
- **52 feature-extraction tests pass**. Tests include real-data downstream classification, partial and complete projection bases, independent analytic generalized eigenpairs at several ranks and scales, unit normalization, input preservation, zero between-class scatter and the singular-scatter error.
- Full suite: **762 passed, 3 skipped**. The same added tests are the only failures in the base full-suite run.
- Repository-wide isort and Black checks pass. Changed Python files pass Flake8; the repository-wide Flake8 report uses the project's existing `--exit-zero` mode. `git diff --check`, wheel/sdist builds and strict Twine metadata checks pass.

### Pull request checklist

- [x] Added a changelog entry.
- [x] Added regression tests and updated public attribute documentation.
- [x] Ran the focused and full test suites.
- [x] Checked formatting and package builds.

submissions.name: bias-variance-fresh-models
submissions.head: 2e79a665321121520549bf412718dec2e9c1f2be
submissions.title: Fit independent cloned models for bias-variance resamples
submissions.body:
### Description

`bias_variance_decomp` fits the same estimator for every bootstrap sample. With a warm-start random forest, later fits keep the first fitted trees, so the reported model variance can collapse to approximately `5.83e-32` instead of the independently refitted value `0.22807814`. Prefitted estimators and pipelines can also carry training state into subsequent resamples.

Clone scikit-learn-compatible estimators for each resample before fitting. This makes each replicate independent and leaves the caller's fitted estimator unchanged. Keep the existing Keras reset path and the legacy behavior for custom estimators without `get_params`; forward fit parameters to each fresh fit. Document the model-state behavior and add a changelog entry.

Fixes #1313. The related earlier [bootstrap-point632 change](https://github.com/Afloat16/mlxtend/commit/d80718f294561d7670099afb069815f3374cf6bb) addresses a separate public evaluation path; this change fixes bias/variance decomposition and its distinct replicate-statistics calculation.

### Validation

Base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.

[Reproducible validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43875962981/job/133328944380) uses the unchanged frozen dependencies: Python 3.11.18, NumPy 2.4.0, SciPy 1.16.3, scikit-learn 1.8.0 and pandas 2.3.3.

- The 19 new cases produce **13 failures and 6 passing controls on the exact base**; all pass after the change.
- **38 focused/adjacent tests pass, 2 skip**. Independent factory-created estimators provide the reference predictions and bias/variance formulas. Cases cover warm-start regression forests, gradient boosting, classification forests, pipelines, prefitted callers, unchanged caller state, cold-start controls and fit-parameter forwarding.
- Full suite: **759 passed, 3 skipped**. The same 13 regressions are the only base full-suite failures.
- Repository-wide isort and Black checks pass. Changed Python files pass Flake8; the repository-wide Flake8 report uses the project's existing `--exit-zero` mode. `git diff --check`, wheel/sdist builds and strict Twine metadata checks pass.

### Pull request checklist

- [x] Added a changelog entry.
- [x] Added regression tests and documented estimator-state behavior.
- [x] Ran focused, adjacent and full test suites.
- [x] Checked formatting and package builds.

style_followup.scope: Full repository isort and Black checked on exact base and PR #1306/#1307/#1310/#1311 heads; harness asserts all exit codes are zero. Full Flake8 is a report-only check.
